verdict.rationale: Workers documents its own "built-in observability," linked to Workers logs, which gives some visibility into how Workers perform. The pack does not show any visitor-behavior or traffic analytics. The AI Gateway metrics and DNS Analytics MCP server belong to other products and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented site performance metrics (latency, request/error dashboards) for Workers, visitor behavior analytics (page views, visitors, geography), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can track site performance and visitor behavior with built-in analytics
